messages.subject: "warm" parameter clarification
parts:
Hey all!

I wanted to clarify how the "warm" parameter works in the micro_era5/etc functions. I see in the code that it alters the air temperatures; that carries through to everything else, right? Meaning, soil temperature will also increase because it's dependent on what the air temperature is, etc. Or does "warm" just influence air temperature and leave everything else alone?

Best
Adam

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: "warm" parameter clarification
parts:
Hi Adam,

It just adds the value you put in there (positive or negative, so you can of course cool as well) to the input 'weather station' air temperatures. This will indeed affect soil temperature (and sky temperature) by roughly the same factor, though the soil temperature will interact with soil moisture/evaporation in nonlinear ways that may mean it's not quite an additive effect on soil temperature (with consequences also for local air temperature, wind speed and humidity).

All the best,
Mike
